title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
abstract: arXiv:2610.37175v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. We introduce MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B that predicts a program's terminal output (error traces, training logs, and validation scores) from its code and data description without executing it, together with a confidence score estimating the prediction's correctness. Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents. We build five TTS policies, guided by MLE-World, that compare several candidates per step by their predicted outputs: Sequential revision, Best-of-N, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a UCB style rule that also adds an exploration bonus from this confidence score. translated_title: MLE-World：利用学习到的世界模型预测机器学习实验结果
translated_abstract: AI研究智能体能够提出、执行并改进解决机器学习任务的程序。然而，执行每个候选程序都需要训练和评估ML模型，这限制了智能体在每一步所能探索的候选数量。我们提出了MLE-World，这是一个从Qwen3.5-4B微调而来的世界模型，它能够在不执行程序的情况下，仅凭程序的代码和数据描述预测程序的终端输出（错误追踪、训练日志和验证分数），并同时给出一个估计预测正确性的置信度分数。由于一次预测只需一次推理调用而非一次训练运行，MLE-World使测试时扩展（TTS）对这些智能体而言变得经济可行。我们在MLE-World的引导下构建了五种TTS策略，通过预测输出在每一步比较多个候选方案：顺序修订、Best-of-N、成对评判、Fusion（融合），以及一种UCB风格的规则，后者还利用置信度分数添加了探索奖励。
tldr: 提出从Qwen3.5-4B微调的世界模型MLE-World，无需实际执行程序即可预测机器学习实验的终端输出和置信度，以低成本推理替代昂贵的训练运行，使AI研究智能体的测试时扩展（TTS）变得经济可行。
en_tdlr: MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B, predicts ML program outputs (error traces, training logs, validation scores) without execution, making test-time scaling affordable for AI research agents through five prediction-guided TTS policies.
